title: D.C. Circuit denies Anthropic petitions over Pentagon supply-chain exclusion
summary: The D.C. Circuit denied Anthropic’s petitions challenging the Department of War’s action removing Claude from its supply chain. The opinion records an order to remove Anthropic products from department systems and bar contractors from using them for department work.
